# DEX fleet — agent map

> Non-custodial payment rails on Base (chainId 8453). Every contract below is live mainnet; every selector is keccak-derived from the signature shown.
> An agent pays by sending the ONE call named per product. No API key, no account, no server.

## How an agent pays
1. Read the product page (URL below) for the full flow and a live check.
2. Send the call to the CONTRACT address, with ERC20 args in base units (USDC here is 6 dp: 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913).
3. Fees go to the treasury 0x5c0fc0917260A0656D253f1625053e3E6Dd2Ef3c; every fee-bearing page reads its bps LIVE (owner-mutable).
4. Nothing is custodial: funds move payer -> vault/escrow, never into a server.

- USDC on Base: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913` (6 dp)
- treasury: `0x5c0fc0917260A0656D253f1625053e3E6Dd2Ef3c`
- explorer: https://basescan.org

## Products

### miniapp — Pay in-feed (Farcaster / Base mini app)
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/miniapp/
- what: A pay link inside a Farcaster cast or Base mini app: tap, pay USDC on Base, receipt in the thread. The deposit address is derived live from the P2 Registry's predict(), and the fee is read live on-chain.
- contract (P2 Registry (the mini app derives its deposit address)): `0x417c41d406c61E09958032Cd77338fc1F1ac7D45`
- fee: 500 bps on each forwarded payment (the P2 Registry's fee, paid by the forwarder the link derives) — live value in the check below

### p2-forwarder — Micro-payment forwarder
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/p2-forwarder/
- what: Register once, get a personal deposit address. Anything sent there auto-forwards to YOUR destination within ~1 block.
- contract (Registry (integrator entry point)): `0x417c41d406c61E09958032Cd77338fc1F1ac7D45`
- call: `register(address)`  selector `0x4420e486`
- call: `forward(address,address)`  selector `0x95ccf8bf`
- payment verb: register(address destination) -> your deposit address; then anyone sends ERC20 to it and it auto-forwards
- fee: 500 bps on each forwarded payment — live value in the check below

### g2b-escrow — Escrow as a service
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/g2b-escrow/
- what: Lock a token amount against a hashlock or a nominated arbiter, share the escrow address, counterparty releases it — or the payer refunds after the timeout. Funds sit in the escrow contract, never a server.
- contract (EscrowFactory (the only contract a user calls)): `0x4B05fA6aD0Ba0D0120Dce19Ce34dde6d1316C237`
- call: `create(address,address,uint256,bytes32,uint64)`  selector `0xa083c5e1`
- payment verb: create(address counterparty, address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 hashlock, uint64 timeout) -> escrow; release with the preimage, refund after timeout, or arbiter release/refund
- fee: 500 bps on release only, nothing on refund — live value in the check below

### g4b-receipts — Receipt NFT (proof-of-payment)
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/g4b-receipts/
- what: When a g2b escrow settles, anyone may mint exactly one on-chain receipt NFT to the payer. Fully on-chain tokenURI (base64 JSON) — no server, no IPFS.
- contract (ReceiptNFT (ERC-721)): `0xAE5951d25FEDD06aB7e124e91Dac3AC20f5e7cAF`
- call: `mintForEscrow(address)`  selector `0xa98aeecb`
- payment verb: mintForEscrow(address escrow) — mint the one proof-of-payment NFT for a SETTLED escrow
- fee: mintFeeWei = 50000000000000 wei (0.00005 ETH) live; free at deploy — live value in the check below

### p3-router — Slippage-bounded swap router
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/p3-router/
- what: An on-chain router that aggregates existing Uniswap V3 + Aerodrome pools (holds no liquidity of its own). Quotes are chosen off-chain; the contract executes the hops it is handed.
- contract (Router (Base mainnet)): `0x036645cA607Dc8075Ae9B12A3474C00A82c306e6`
- call: `swapExactTokensForTokens((uint256,uint256,(uint8,address,address,uint24,bool,address,address)[],address,uint256))`  selector `0xd3bd0b52`
- payment verb: swapExactTokensForTokens(ExactInputParams) — executable hops handed in; quotes are chosen off-chain
- fee: 500 bps (5%) on input, to the treasury — immutable in the contract

### f1c-duster — Dust funnel (dust -> USDC)
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/f1c-duster/
- what: Connect a wallet, see scattered dust balances, one click sweeps them to USDC on Base. Non-custodial, stateless contract.
- contract (DustSweeper): `0x8c38c2bbECa7575c24ACEf1d907Aa1F4f43CbFB9`
- call: `sweep(address[],(uint8,address,address,uint24,address)[],uint256[])`  selector `0xe7ea3ccb`
- payment verb: sweep(address[] tokens, HopInput[] hops, uint256[] minOut) — one tx funnels scattered dust to USDC
- fee: ZERO fee by design (acquisition funnel)

### g2a-streams — Payment streams
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/g2a-streams/
- what: Create a streaming payment: a vault drips a token to a recipient over time; the recipient withdraws whatever has vested, permissionlessly.
- contract (StreamFactory (Base mainnet)): `0x3882A049ee99B96Ea68DF317713ed76008b9A075`
- call: `approve(address,uint256)`  selector `0x095ea7b3`
- call: `createStream(address,address,uint256,uint64,uint64)`  selector `0x88379c90`
- call: `withdraw()`  selector `0x3ccfd60b`
- payment verb: approve(factory, amount) then createStream(recipient, token, amount, start, end); the recipient (or anyone) calls withdraw() on the vault as it vests
- fee: 500 bps, charged only on withdraw — live value in the check below

### g2a-subscriptions — Subscriptions (recurring toll)
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/subscribe/
- what: Recurring payments on the SAME factory — no new contract. A payer pre-approves a small allowance; each period a fresh vault is minted for the next window and pulled. A missed period is a HOLE, not a debt.
- contract (StreamFactory (reused)): `0x3882A049ee99B96Ea68DF317713ed76008b9A075`
- call: `approve(address,uint256)`  selector `0x095ea7b3`
- call: `createStreamFor(address,address,address,uint256,uint64,uint64)`  selector `0x2f7a1c66`
- payment verb: approve(factory, ticket * periods) — ONE signature, bounded (not max-uint); a keeper then calls createStreamFor once per period from that allowance. Revoke anytime with approve(factory, 0).
- fee: per-period fee to the merchant (live bps read from the factory)

### f1a-payment-links — Payment links
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/f1a-payment-links/
- what: Create a payment request; you get a URL carrying a deposit address that auto-forwards to you. No account, no wallet, no code. The link is minted by the RequestRegistry and pays a forwarder derived from it.
- contract (RequestRegistry): `0xeD395024Bba719564bec617b6b42CF6fDC8a252c`
- call: `request(address,address,uint256,bytes32)`  selector `0xdc0edd60`
- payment verb: request(address destination, address token, uint256 amount, bytes32 memo) -> a request id; the link hands over a deposit address that auto-forwards to the destination
- fee: 500 bps on each forwarded payment (the P2 Registry's fee, paid by the forwarder it derives) — live value in the check below

### sdk — TypeScript SDK (@fleet/sdk)
- what: A tree-shakeable viem client: pure {to,data,value} calldata builders for every rail (quote/pay/createLink/createEscrow/release/setMandate/executeLap/swap/sweep/verify402) plus an EIP-712 signing seam. No state at import; addresses are data you pass in.
- contract (TypeScript client (no contract)): **none — source only, not deployed**
- source: products/sdk/README.md  ·  listed on the landing at https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/#build
- payment verb: pure {to,data,value} builders for every surface (pay/quote/createEscrow/release/setMandate/executeLap/swap/sweep/verify402) + an EIP-712 seam — no state, no RPC at import
- fee: none of its own — the rail it calls charges the fee

### mcp-server — MCP server (agent tools)
- what: One line of config gives an agent live, non-custodial rails on Base: one tool per product returns the calldata for the ONE money call and simulates it (dry-run by default) before anything is signed. No API key, no account.
- contract (MCP server (no contract)): **none — source only, not deployed**
- source: products/mcp-server/README.md  ·  listed on the landing at https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/#build
- payment verb: one MCP tool per product: returns the calldata for the product's ONE money call and simulates it (dry-run) before anything is signed
- fee: none of its own — the rail it calls charges the fee

### x402 — x402 facilitator (on-chain 402 gate)
- listed on the landing at https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/#build
- what: The on-chain half of an HTTP-402 flow: a server returns 402, the client pays a rail, a gated writer records the settlement, and the server verifies it with a VIEW call then serves the resource. Nothing holds funds.
- contract (x402Facilitator): `0x5849eF6f21fDC21d5194c24ED6c824965A613739`
- call: `verify(bytes32,address,address,uint256)`  selector `0x796e926d`
- payment verb: verify(paymentId, to, token, minAmount) — a VIEW a server calls to gate a resource; a gated writer feeds markPaid from the rail's Paid event
- fee: none — the rail that settled the payment charged its fee

### settlement — Settlement registry (read-side paid())
- listed on the landing at https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/#build
- what: A read-side mirror of a rail's settlement: a gated writer records paymentId -> (amount, at); anyone reads paid()/isPaid(). markPaid is idempotent, so an id can never silently change meaning.
- contract (SettlementRegistry): `0xdDA0728Ff635B555D2Af471E2821055bE08F9127`
- call: `paid(bytes32)`  selector `0xadd89bb2`
- call: `isPaid(bytes32)`  selector `0xfeef6640`
- payment verb: paid(paymentId) -> (amount, at) and isPaid(paymentId) — a read-side mirror; a gated writer calls markPaid(bytes32,uint256)
- fee: none — read-side only

### fleet-executor — Fleet executor (EIP-7702 batch delegate)
- page: https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/fleet-executor/
- what: One installed EIP-7702 delegate drives every fleet surface from a single off-chain EIP-712 signature over a whole batch of (target,value,data) — so the user's own code runs in the user's frame, and any relayer can carry it.
- contract (FleetExecutor): `0x410396662089a26C801c54818CCd59640eFCaf77`
- call: `execute((address,uint256,bytes)[],uint256,uint256,bytes)`  selector `0x74b506ec`
- payment verb: execute(calls, nonce, deadline, sig) — an EIP-712 signed BATCH of (target,value,data) run in the delegating EOA's frame; any relayer carries it
- fee: none — per-sponsored-tx billing is the paymaster's, next door

### fleet-paymaster — Fleet paymaster (ERC-4337 sponsorship)
- listed on the landing at https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/#build
- what: An ERC-4337 v0.7 verifying paymaster that sponsors UserOps calling a fleet contract and charges the sponsorship back as a small additive surcharge on the rail fee (sponsorBps, default 10) — not in ETH. Allow-list + per-sender rate limit. The allow-list is a DECLARATION gate: word 0 of the op's callData is trusted, so a sponsored op can still call a non-listed contract. Rate limit is OFF by default (maxOpsPerWindow == 0 = unlimited).
- contract (FleetPaymaster): `0x70A615dDc4cd013Cf4D569Ae3394bF4465229B95`
- call: `previewSponsorFee(uint256)`  selector `0x23202bee`
- payment verb: previewSponsorFee(base) then deposit(); validatePaymasterUserOp sponsors allow-listed UserOps and accrues a surcharge on the rail fee
- fee: sponsorBps default 10 bps, additive to the rail fee, paid in the RAIL TOKEN not ETH. Owner-settable up to a compiled-in MAX_SPONSOR_BPS = 1000 (10%); lowering it needs a redeploy (constant, no setter). COMBINED worst case = rail fee (<=500 bps) + sponsorBps (<=1000 bps) = 1500 bps (15%); at defaults = 500+10 = 510 bps (5.1%).

### g4c-toll-registry — Toll registry (per-product toll lookup)
- listed on the landing at https://dngr2.github.io/dex-products/#build
- what: A constructor-set, per-chain lookup: product -> (recipient, feeBps, live) in ONE call, so a new product's toll is registered rather than re-derived. A consumer pins the registry's codehash; live=false reverts rather than falling back to a compiled default.
- contract (TollRegistry): `0xc8319D6fbc0A8f1685Df9c567557141A289b7A1b`
- call: `toll(bytes32)`  selector `0x71a41241`
- call: `isLive(bytes32)`  selector `0xcedd3a0e`
- payment verb: toll(product) -> (recipient, feeBps, live) in one call; a consumer pins the registry codehash and divides by the literal 10_000
- fee: none — it reports other products' tolls

## Drive it from an agent (MCP)

Every call above is also a tool on the `dex-fleet` MCP server (one tool per product),
which returns the calldata for the ONE call and simulates it (dry-run by default) before
anything is signed — no npm, no account. One line of config:

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "dex-fleet": {
  "command": "python3",
  "args": ["products/mcp-server/server.py"] } } }
```

Tools: create_pay_link · pay · escrow_create · escrow_release · stream_create · subscribe ·
swap · sweep_dust · sponsored_call · mint_receipt · read_fee (live bps per contract).
Build: `products/mcp-server/` (README + selftest).
